immediate_stop: the authorization record is not present on main after a separately reviewed human-approved merge
an invitation has not passed the individual invitation-review checklist
a mass post, scraping, automated message, unsolicited bulk email, or more than one initial invitation or one follow-up per candidate is attempted
10 initial invitations, 3 enrolled participants, or any other recruitment budget is reached or the next action would exceed it
a nonresponse is treated as consent or participation is not voluntary and unpaid
credentials, private-repository content, employer-confidential code, customer data, proprietary logs, submitted source code, or raw private logs are requested, accessed, or retained
participant-task execution, an AEG query on a participant task, or model-assisted diagnosis or repair is attempted
an external-project code change, issue, comment, or pull request is attempted

payment, paid acquisition, participant identity or submission publication, result publication, experience promotion, verified-library change, Stage B activity, or Scheduled Task enablement is attempted
a participant withdraws or declines consent for a recruitment record still being retained
candidate_exclusion: the candidate does not actively use a coding agent or lacks a current real software task
repository ownership or authorization cannot be established without accessing a private repository
an objective reproducible oracle is unavailable
a correct public repair is already known during initial screening
the sensitive-data boundary is not accepted or candid negative feedback is unlikely
completion: 3 consenting eligible Stage A participants are enrolled
10 individually reviewed initial invitations have been sent without reaching 3 enrollments
a stopping condition occurs or the human reviewer closes the authorization
